{{Top|leg}}
'''Deafness''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The caster of the spell could cause a target to lose their sense of hearing, rendering them deaf. Proficient Ascendants could affect multiple targets at a time.
